question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **intervention**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Collateral**: Accompanying as secondary or subordinate. **किसी अन्‍य से जुड़ी हुई या संबंधित किंतु कम महत्वपूर्ण; गौण, आनुषंगिक**
 
• **Intervention**: refers to the action or process of intervening, which can mean several things depending on the context. **हस्‍तक्षेप**
 
• **Convention**: A usual or accepted way of behaving, especially in social situations. **प्रथा, परिपाटी, परंपरा, रिवाज**
 
• **Physical**: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind. **शारीरिक**
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: A comprehensive knowledge of the causes and effects of scholastic stress is therefore necessary to develop effective and efficient remedial solutions.
 
• So, "**intervention**" is the correct word choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete passage: *Academic life has (1) become __demanding for students as a result of different internal and external expectations. Teenagers are especially __(2) prone__ to academic stress because they go through so many personal and social changes. As a result, designing effective and efficient **__(3) intervention__** solutions requires a thorough understanding of the causes and consequences of academic stress. Exams are one of the (4) __ __ aspects of anyone's life. Exams are stressful for everyone, whether they are students or adults because everyone wants to perform well and no one wants to fail as to avoid (5) __ __ in future.*
